answer: One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Flaxbound jacket stamper silk licence sees to it, since a licence jacket stampers carry after tailor shop audits. Before the stamp comes a deposit of 26 credits, frozen until 5 days after the grading closes, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Every canyon is counted once. One timber, one entry. The yarrow is checked, not assumed.
